title: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
description: These fluffy lemon ricotta pancakes are made from scratch using Chef John's recipe for delicious, soft, and tender pancakes with bright zesty flavor.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest (just the yellow part of the skin)

steps.text: Whisk cold water and baking soda in a mixing bowl. Add ricotta cheese, egg, lemon zest, vegetable oil, sugar, and vanilla; whisk until smooth, breaking up any lumps of cheese as you mix.
Whisk in 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons self-rising flour, melted butter, and lemon juice until most of flour disappears into batter. Let batter sit at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Heat a lightly oiled griddle over medium-high heat.

Drop batter by large spoonfuls onto the hot griddle and cook until bubbles form and the edges are dry, 2 to 3 minutes. Flip and cook until browned on the other side, 2 to 3 minutes. Repeat with remaining batter.

video.description: Achieve the exceptional cakey softness of diner pancakes with this ricotta cheese twist on the traditional pancake batter! Combine water, baking soda and ricotta cheese with freshly grated lemon zest, vegetable oil, vanilla and egg, and whisk until smooth, then add freshly juiced lemon and self-rising flour and stir just until mixed. Allow all the ingredients to rest, then portion over medium high heat and cook until fluffy and serve with a finish of butter, lemon zest and maple syrup. You’ll love the exceptional citrusy flavor and texture of these tasty and comforting flapjacks!
